<observations>
Date: Jul 6, 2026
* 🔴 (09:45) User stated max guest count is 150.
* 🟢 (11:05) User noted cousin Thomas has severe peanut allergies.
* 🔴 (13:10) User stated floral budget max is $4,500; prefers minimalist gold geometric table centerpieces.
* 🟡 (Day summary) Agent reviewed vegetarian brunch catering, updated master guest count spreadsheet, emailed caterer regarding allergen protocols, reviewed Seattle floral portfolios, and configured RSVP automation.

Date: Jul 9, 2026
* 🔴 (09:15) User stated wedding hashtag is #ToHaveAndToHolt2026; rehearsal dinner venue is Harbor View Restaurant.
* 🔴 (17:50) User stated photographer arrival should be two hours before the ceremony.
* 🟡 (Day summary) Agent updated website banner, compiled acoustic indie Spotify playlist, drafted Harbor View reservation for 22, contacted Metro Luxury Transit for ADA shuttles, and checked pyrotechnic fire safety codes.

Date: Jul 12, 2026
* 🔴 (09:10) User stated seating chart must separate college friends from family; catering headcount cutoff is Sept 1, 2026.
* 🔴 (17:50) User stated morning getting-ready robes must be emerald green silk.
* 🟡 (Day summary) Agent checked Velvet Petals for lavender centerpieces, researched regional snack welcome bags, checked custom ring engraving with Silver Lining Jewelers, and added a zero-proof botanical spritz to the bar menu draft.

Date: Jul 15, 2026
* 🔴 (09:15) User stated rehearsal dinner headcount cap is 40.
* 🔴 (15:20) User stated venue walkthrough is Aug 26, 2026.
* 🔴 (18:00) User stated dietary restriction labels must be printed on place cards.
* 🟡 (Day summary) Agent checked sunrise photography rates, ordered leaf-based confetti samples, added emergency kit supplies, checked amber uplighting packages, and checked 1965 vintage convertible availability.

Date: Jul 19, 2026
* 🔴 (09:00) User stated college friends must be grouped at table four.
* 🔴 (12:45) User stated ring bearer pillow must be handmade from vintage lace.
* 🔴 (16:30) User stated welcome bags must include local craft beer and artisan chocolate.
* 🟡 (Day summary) Agent updated floral design brief with white roses and eucalyptus, compiled 20-song acoustic indie setlist, searched Etsy for vintage lace pillows, and adjusted evening timeline for 45-minute sunset portraits.

Date: Jul 23, 2026
* 🔴 (09:15) User stated final rehearsal dinner headcount is strictly 35 guests at The Rustic Hearth.
* 🔴 (13:10) User stated wedding favors must be personalized ceramic coasters (ordered via Kiln & Clay Studio).
* 🔴 (16:45) User stated cake flavor is pistachio (replacing lemon raspberry).
* 🔴 (17:00) User stated final videographer payment is due Aug 10, 2026.
* 🟡 (Day summary) Updated getting-ready robes to pure mulberry silk, added a midnight return shuttle run, and added pre-ceremony candid coffee photography coverage.
* ✅ (21:00) Agent confirmed gluten-free macaron tower addition with Sweet Treats Bakery.
</observations>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to provide the next wedding planning request.
</suggested-response>
